density.basis: Exact rectangle-integrated cosine moments in actual predicted bbox; non-DC coefficients normalized by public mass A
density.aggregation: Mean of two normalized inverse-spectrum weighted squared coefficient sums
density.bbox_derivatives: Full differentiation through predicted min/max bounds; no detached surrogate gradient
density.limitations: Finite-mode uniformity proxy, not exact void or legality. No 1/B amplitude dilution, but geometric expansion may still improve uniformity and is penalized separately.

selection: Current-epoch objective shared by train/backward/dev. Final best, LR and early stop start epoch16, final objective only. Terminal-total diagnostic never selects early checkpoints.
